title: September's Leaders And Laggards
text: Technology was the place to be among September's biggest S&P 500 winners, accounting for 13 of the month's 20 best-performing stocks. Everpure led the winners with a 40.70% gain, ahead of Moderna, Intel, and Bloom Energy, which each rallied more than 30%.

title: Rediker: Powell Is a ‘Tempering Influence' on Fed Board
text: Doug Rediker, Managing Partner at International Capital Strategies and formerly represented the US on the Executive Board of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), says former Fed Chair Jerome Powell's continued presence on the Board of Governors is a “tempering influence” on current Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. Rediker says he has been reluctant to think the Fed would raise rates because of the proximity to the midterm elections, though he says he is not highly confident in that view.
